test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 11 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

STERN
solution: The correct answer is '**strict**'. ***__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate synonym of the given word '**Stern**' is **Strict**'. • **Stern**: very serious; not smiling. (कठोर, बहुत गंभीर; मुस्‍कान-रहित) • *Example: His voice was **stern** again.* • **Strict**: not allowing people to break rules or behave badly. [सख्‍़त, कठोर (नियम भंग या ग़लत व्‍यवहार को सहन न करने वाला)] • *Example: Samir’s very **strict** with his children.* **Correct Answer:__** strict.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the **meaning **of other words: • **mild**: not strong; not very bad. (नरम; हलका) • **lenient**: (used about punishment or person who punishes) not as strict as expected. [(दंड या दंड देने वाला व्‍यक्ति) जो आशा के अनुरूप कठोर न हो; नरम, सौम्‍य] • **gentle**: (used about people) kind and calm; touching or treating people or things in a careful way so that they are not hurt. [(व्‍यक्ति) दयालु और शांत; बिना चोट पहुँचाए कोमलता से व्‍यवहार करने वाला; सौम्‍य] 38:Tab3, The correct answer is** 'Why did you spent'.**
